run_video_feature_extraction: run the test_mq module to extract video clip features and save embeddings as pt files for offline retrieval
run_with_config_and_split: run test_mq with a config file and data split to extract FrozenInTime model video embeddings on GPU
run_with_sliding_window_augmentation: run test_mq with sliding window stride for test time temporal augmentation across video clips
run_batched_feature_extraction: run test_mq with custom batch size to extract video features using memory efficient batched processing
run_resume_checkpoint_extraction: run test_mq resuming from a checkpoint to extract video embeddings skipping already processed clips
